items.meaning: A member sees the season rehearsal calendar and marks attendance for each rehearsal.
items.row: The site should let a member see the rehearsal calendar for the season and say whether they are coming to each one

items.meaning: Attendance for a rehearsal is known by the Monday before.
items.row: we need to know by the Monday before if we have enough tenors

items.meaning: When a member misses three rehearsals in a row before a concert, the section leader is told so a person can call; no automatic email to the member.
items.row: If someone misses three rehearsals in a row before a concert, the section leader should be told so they can call them, not an automatic email, a person

items.meaning: The annual fee is 120 lei; the site shows who has paid.
items.row: The membership fee is 120 lei a year and we need to see who has paid

items.meaning: Fee reminders go to unpaid members in February and again in March.
items.row: a reminder going out in February and again in March to those who have not paid

items.meaning: Waiting list: people add their name and voice part themselves; the committee picks who joins, not first come first served.
items.row: The waiting list people should be able to put their name and voice part on the site themselves, and when a place opens the committee picks someone, it is not first come first served

items.meaning: Members over 70 pay half and the site applies it without anyone remembering.
items.row: members over 70 pay half, and we should not have to remember who that is

items.meaning: Sheet music PDFs are behind the member login and not available to the waiting list.
items.row: Sheet music: we have the right to share PDFs with members only, so they must be behind a login and not downloadable by the waiting list

items.meaning: Concert dates show the dress code and call time; a public page lists the next three concerts with a link to Eventbook for tickets.
items.row: Concert dates with the dress code and the call time, and a page the public can see with the next three concerts and a way to buy tickets, we use a third party for tickets (Eventbook) so just a link

items.meaning: The site is the source of truth for membership, not the notebook.
items.row: Carmen wants to keep the notebook, that is fine, but the site is the truth

must_not_invent: an automatic email to a member who missed rehearsals
notes: Prose only. The model must find ten items in sentences and keep the negatives: "not an automatic email, a person" and "not first come first served". G05-02 is an ambiguity flag candidate (whose deadline is it, and what happens after Monday); G05-10 could be dropped as not a requirement or kept as a principle, both accepted. "Half of whom left years ago" is background, not an item.
